title: fix(billing): include BYOP markup in preflight budget checks
author: iotserver24
pr_body_excerpt:
Fixes #10736

Preflight admitted requests against the **baseline** estimate, then deduction charged **baseline + 25% BYOP markup**. A key budget of `1.10` with estimate `1.00` would pass `checkBalance` and then debit `1.25`, leaving the budget negative.

## Changes

1. **`byopClientAllowsMarkup`** — same eligibility as `resolveDevMarkup` (live `pk_`, earnings on, not self-spend).
2. **Auth** — join the publishable key’s prefix/enabled/expiry/metadata and set `apiKey.byopMarkupApplies` on the already-loaded row. No extra D1 hit in preflight.
3. **`checkBalance`** — when markup applies, require `round(baseline + computeDevCredit(baseline))`, same rounding as the ledger.

Earnings-disabled / owner-spend BYOP keys still preflight at baseline.

## Tests

`npx vitest run src/byop-markup.test.ts` — 23 passed.

gist.headline: The budget learned arithmetic
gist.blurb: BYOP requests now check the same total they will actually spend. The ledger and the garden gate have finally agreed on what 25% means.
gist.summary: Fixed BYOP preflight budget checks so eligible live publishable keys require the rounded baseline estimate plus the 25% developer-credit markup, matching the amount charged by the ledger.
gist.impact: A key with a 1.10 budget and a 1.00 baseline estimate will now be checked against the actual 1.25 charge before generation, while earnings-disabled and owner-spend BYOP keys continue to use the baseline estimate.
